items.title: Finiteness of the fibre product module over the fibre product ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the fibre product of a finite module over one ring and a finite module over another, matched over a common quotient, is finite over the fibre product ring whenever each ingredient is finite over its own ring. The proof recalls that the structure map from the fibre product ring onto the fibre product of the two rings is surjective, observes that the constructed module is naturally a module over that surjective quotient, applies the earlier finiteness criterion for fibre products of rings to conclude finiteness over the quotient, and then descends finiteness along the surjection.
